headline: A 2017 executive order directing steps to strengthen cybersecurity for federal government computer networks and the nation's critical infrastructure.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order directs the federal government to improve the security of its own computer networks. It also addresses protecting critical infrastructure, the key systems the country depends on, from cyber threats. No official summary was provided, so the specific requirements and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.how: They are directed to take steps to strengthen the cybersecurity of their computer networks.
The order addresses the cybersecurity of the essential systems they run, though the specific effects on them are not described in the source material.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 11, 2017; executive orders generally take effect when signed.
